$comment: W42 G0 instrument: the tolerances clause 2 requires G0 to declare BEFORE the proofs run.
Committed before any proof output exists (git history is the timestamp). Each bar is no looser than
what the grounding readers achieved (charter clause 2): memo C recovered lam and w to +-0.03 and widths
to +-0.05 CSS px at the quantisation floor (rms 0.40-0.42); memo B recovered widths within 3-10 % and
the share within 0.03-0.1 at 2x on vitrea's captures; memo E recovered k to three decimals at rms
0.40-0.42 and separated the wrong reading by >= 2.60 codes and the wrong unit by >= 4.65; memo C's
two-sided control read the mirror statistic <= 0.024 at p >= 8.
A reader that misses its bar in proof 1 or proof 3 does not read Apple (clause 2's stop). A parameter
proof 1 cannot recover to its bar is declared NON-IDENTIFIABLE on this bed before any fit, never

synthetic_render.T: memo C's native-T table (tone.memo_c_T), per endpoint and span, applied per channel
synthetic_render.quantisation: y = round(T(M) + U(-0.5, 0.5)), clipped to 0..255 (memo C / memo E's convention)

k_n, k_w (LT-2k).note: k_n is identified only by cells with t > 0 in the active pose

proof1_family_recovery.discrete choices (support, edge mode, C-: the true choice's pooled rms at the floor (<= 0.45) and every wrong choice >= 0.10 code worse pooled

model reader (memo C).scope: cells whose narrow width is flat in depth (receded, and active t = 0); on depth-graded cells it reads an effective width, reported, not gated

pitch-64 heavy reader.support call: the true support ranks first wherever the supports differ by > 0.05 code rms

ESF reader (memo B).sigma: within 3 % of the rendered effective narrow width

step reader (family D).support and edge-mode call: the true one ranks first wherever they differ by > 0.05 code rms

rule: For a truth family A and a fitted family B: B is fitted to A's quantised synthetic render by least
squares, then refined by minimax on the region statistics (regions.py) of A's exact render.
s = max over cells and region statistics of |B's statistic - A's statistic| at that optimum.
DISTINGUISHED if s > 1.5 codes (B fails clause 6's max(1 code, bar) with room for the median's own
0.5-code quantisation); UNRESOLVED if s < 0.5 (B survives on A's truth); MARGINAL between, where the
verdict depends on the measured bar. An unresolved or marginal pair is a bed question and is
reported with the cell or family that would separate it.

proof3_vitrea.T: tone.SrgbAffineT (vitrea's body is affine in linear light, then encoded)
proof3_vitrea.truth: the code's kernels: memo B's code-map (kernels.json, SHA-256 9c684eb9...) and its float64 replica (kernel_sim.py 98d00dc9..., verify.py 45f54862...)

model reader, linear space.sigma_n: within 20 % of the body kernel's sigma_RMS
model reader, linear space.sigma_w: within 25 % (the platykurtic L4 reads low or wide as a Gaussian)

pitch-64 heavy reader.canvas vs footprint: no false footprint call: within 0.04 code rms

proof3_vitrea.every other reader: reads the code's two-sided linear body: lam within 0.12 of 0 in the linear reading, a flat narrow width in depth, the canvas-wide W
proof3_vitrea.known-space control: the ENCODED reading of vitrea's linear captures is reported (memo C: lam 1.4-1.5); the knee is established by S and by every linear fit's loss, never by lam alone
